title: Appeal tribunal.
bodyText:
A. Appeal Procedure

Appeals shall be heard by an impartial referee for temporary disability benefits appeals who shall be appointed by the director and who shall serve as the appeal tribunal.
bodyHtml:
PART V.  DETERMINATIONS

 

A.  Appeal Procedure

 

     [§392-71]  Appeal tribunal.  Appeals shall be heard by an impartial referee for temporary disability benefits appeals who shall be appointed by the director and who shall serve as the appeal tribunal. [L 1969, c 148, pt of §1]
